notes:
• Added a new option under About: Help File. It will send you to a google docs with a new and easier help file to read!
  • Added a new option under the Analyze Menu: Show Detailed References. Disabled by default. Resource references are now displayed in a compact format by default.
  • Added support for RPG Maker MZ Effekseer Effects (.efkefc) in resource analysis, reports, and backup operations.
  • Added a new option under the Project menu: Recent Projects. It will show the last five projects you opened with the app.
  • Projects are now automatically analyzed whenever they are opened, preventing outdated results from being used to move files.
  • Changed the folder on the root of the rpg maker project where the unused files cleaner saves their config files and backup. It will migrate the older one automatically.
  • Repeated references from the same plugin are grouped together.
  • Exported reports follow the selected reference display mode.
  • Improved resource reference details. Map events now display their event ID, page number, and command. JavaScript references include line numbers.
  • Improved analysis performance by reducing repeated plugin file reads and unnecessary disk operations.
  • Improved dialog scrolling when the available screen space is limited.
  • Fixed previous project data not being transferred until accessing backup-related features.
  • Fixed project-specific settings carrying over when switching between projects.
  • Fixed an issue where disabling autosave was not preserved after reopening a project.
  • Fixed long backup folder paths overflowing the Move Unused Files window.
